## 当前状态：memory 名称稳定性与相机重开（2026-10-06，待最终证据）

本轮正式实现接受默认 memory 名称稳定性与独立相机视图状态；最终资产、统一测试数、exact bindings 和实际浏览器范围待主任务最终收据后填写。见 [当前阶段]({{stage}})、[当前门状态]({{gate}})和[本轮更新前138项原字节]({{archive}})。此预览不能作为已应用当前状态。

默认 memory 名称从 tensor 的 memory role 派生，不再由 `abs(dy)<15` 决定是否存在；已有自定义文字和显式空文字分别保留。正式标签独立矩阵为1个Transformer、45份 detached输入、360份whole/detail输出、2708/2708关系，另有有限水平frontier；它们不是2708产品测试或360个模型。canonical tensor/port/source/IR和原路线/端点策略保持既有合同。垂直15阈值的display端口切换仍未解决：dy14→15时memory路线49→644.3世界单位。尝试取消阈值的候选因新增peer接触/相交被拒绝并冻结，不纳入当前build；局部标签稳定不等于全域视觉通过。

相机视图状态独立于CanvasDocument与undo history，按document/source/IR隔离并绑定visualRevision，以zoom和世界中心支持同标签刷新/重开；实际可验证范围待浏览器最终收据。active pan只预览，终止/取消后保存。初版初始化误比较raw文档与createHistory克隆，真实刷新回到默认90%；原失败已保留，改用正式createHistory的before control22/24、2fail，修后focused24/24和strict0。回调harness不是React挂载或真实手势证明。无自动ResizeObserver、跨标签持久化或模型执行；100%与fit仍是两种显式操作。

历史DuFX/CC91/B_XH三个AI角色保持原build范围，审计者不新增参与者；AI 不计真人。左库仍为17基础模块＋3透明网络起点，无逐种生成/执行认证。旧BTw性能数据仍限定旧时点；304 DOM正文不等于300真实可见对象，rAF 不是实际呈现 FPS。本轮300卡grid准备仍不是可读300-object性能验收，固定硬件/字体A/B×3、持续输入完整分母、presented FPS、人审都未认证。

M4 `partial`、M5 `not_started`、真人 0。新研究包路径、动态旧包清单和冻结准备关系待final readiness填写；准备关系不是使用者任务，五席位未分配/采集。旧gold、矩阵、失败、研究包与第二个`##`起历史正文保持原字节。正式工程从头实现，不依赖Temp runtime/fallback；无新增已认证复用，未执行生成模型。下方旧“当前/最终”按各自build与冻结范围读取。

## Current formal checkout: persistent memory names and camera reopen (2026-10-06, final evidence pending)

The accepted product scope is persistent default memory naming and a separate camera view preference. Final assets, unified test counts, exact bindings and browser scope await the parent receipts. See the [stage]({{stage}}), [gate]({{gate}}) and [138-input pre-change archive]({{archive}}). This preview is not applied current status.

Default memory text derives from the tensor's memory role instead of abs(dy)<15; custom text and explicit empty text keep their meaning. The production label matrix is one Transformer, 45 detached inputs and 360 whole/detail outputs with 2708/2708 relationships, plus bounded horizontal frontiers. These are not 2708 product tests or 360 models. Canonical tensor/port/source/IR facts and the existing route/endpoint policy remain protected. The vertical display-port threshold remains: dy14→15 changes memory route length49→644.3 world units. Side-policy candidates introduced peer contacts/crossings and were rejected and frozen; they are absent from the current build. Stable names do not approve global visual quality.

Camera view state is outside CanvasDocument and undo history. Session storage isolates document/source/IR and binds visualRevision; zoom and world centre support same-tab reopen, subject to final settled browser evidence. Active pan previews do not persist, terminal/cancel does. The first initialization compared a raw document against createHistory's clone and actual reload returned to default90%; that failure is retained. A formal-createHistory before control fails2 of24; the correction passes focused24/24 and strict0. A callback harness does not mount React or prove native gestures. No automatic ResizeObserver or cross-tab persistence is claimed; 100% and fit remain separate actions.

Three historical DuFX/CC91/B_XH AI roles keep their original build scopes; auditors add no participants. AI is not a human participant. The library remains17 base modules and three transparent starts, without per-kind generation/execution certification. Old BTw timing data remain version-qualified;304 DOM bodies are not300 readable visible objects and rAF is not presented FPS. A300-card grid preparation is not a passed readable-workload/performance test. Fixed hardware/fonts A/B×3, continuous input/full denominator, presented performance and human review remain open.

M4 remains partial, M5 not_started, humans 0. A fresh research package path, dynamic older-package inventory and readiness counts await final receipts; readiness is not user task completion and the five seats remain unassigned/uncollected. Old golds, matrices, failures, packages and historical bodies from the second level-two heading remain exact. The formal project is built independently of Temp; no reuse candidate is newly certified and no generated model was executed. Earlier current/final claims retain their named frozen scope.

# M4 memory 名称稳定性与相机视图恢复

这是待最终统一build/browser/readiness的文档预览，尚未应用到current入口。最终填入实际资产、统一检查、源/build bindings、浏览器与导出关系，不用专项数目累加产品测试。M4保持partial、M5not_started、真人0。

## 接受的标签修复

上一阶段实际发现Encoder下移24世界单位会删掉默认memory文字与guide，但tensor仍在。当前默认文字改为memory role派生，在原15阈值外继续存在；自定义文字保持，显式空文字继续隐藏。placement、无箭头guide和diagnostic沿用正式合同。标签存在不能证明每个位置都能安全放置，预算或阻挡必须保留诊断。

production-label-only独立oracle覆盖一份源Transformer、45输入、360whole/detail×paper/monochrome×85/180输出；2708/2708是关系分母，240caption几何与7budget案例分列。原默认标签缺失的before矩阵、负控和所有中间候选保持原字节。原路径/display-port/canonical事实相对匹配before输入必须exact，不能把相机或文字修复扩大为tensor变更。

## 拒绝的端口候选与现存缺口

垂直15阈值仍切换display端口：dy14→15，source端点110.0219、target端点73.1362世界单位位移，路线49→644.3；两侧都显示memory且canonical相同。尝试去除垂直阈值、限制水平side规则和修peer的候选仍引入新peer接触/重叠/相交，独立路线审查未全通过，因此冻结为rejected candidate并恢复label-only正式Scene。候选无未报正文穿过不等于peer美观合格。下一阶段需保持canonical、严格检查具体新增关系，不能通过diagnostic把美观问题称通过。

## 相机状态与真实集成错误

相机保持独立sessionStorage偏好，不新增Canvas/history字段。key包含documentId/sourceBindingDigest/irDigest，内容精确匹配visualRevision；保存zoom、世界中心与捕获viewport，初始化根据新viewport计算平移。malformed/disabled/quota failure安全回退。fit、zoom、focus、pan/reset与新load取消旧票据；preview拒写，终止/取消再写。

真实DRsn build下rev23从100%+32,16pan刷新回默认90%。原因是createHistory克隆document，而initializeCamera要求raw对象引用exact。原24/24harness也用原引用，漏真实clone；该证据不能认证初始化。正式createHistory before control22/24、2fail复现；修复改用identity/revision/load/intent票据和active clone，final24/24、strict0。真实CXutz settled13/14同paper/rev23有限恢复成功，首次AX90%先渲染与后settled100%分别保留。最终build与更多模型/fit/四向/不同viewport范围待parent finalfacts；禁止以未settle截图冒充最终状态。

没有自动ResizeObserver、跨标签持久化或新执行路径。初始化最多4帧等待可用viewport；100%围绕中心设zoom1，fit按bounds计算，两者不同。harness仍不挂载React，真实取消/capture/drawing/history/source/export需各自浏览器证据。

## 300可见对象与性能准备

静态grid准备使用source-backed300叶卡的typed move；scene仍304对象，bounds4588×30542使fit zoom很小。672×641下虽300几何入内，正文仅3.487×1.114CSSpx，名义13字小于0.234px；3800×2100也只有12.755×4.076px与0.855px字。此准备没有真实浏览器样本/解析字体/定时输入，也不满足可读300-object工作负载。历史BTw160/72/160ms、p95160与rAF58.605Hz仍是旧小子集，不是本轮性能改善或presentedFPS。

## 研究与冻结边界

待最终research receipt填入新包、动态旧包清单、readiness关系和5pristine席位。旧包与旧gold原字节不回写，stale官方拒绝保留。准备不等于3–5真实研究者五步任务；AI三历史角色不变，审计者不加人。85/180mm出版人审、真实字体、连续输入/full denominator、presented性能仍open。正式项目从头实现，无Temp fallback，未执行生成模型或语义源码修改。
